title: Coastal Gains Vacation Rental
meta_description: Coastal Gains is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionCoastal GainsInlet Beach | S Wall St, Inlet Beach, FL 32461Home Highlights:4 bedrooms4 bathroomsSleeps up to 14 guests2,200 sq. ft.Gulf-front beach access right outside your door4 complimentary adult bikes included (Bikes not provided Dec–Feb; additional rentals available upon request)Open-concept living area with stylish kitchen, granite countertops, and stainless-steel appliancesFirst-floor bedroom with twin bed, private bath, and stand-alone showerSecond-floor living, dining, kitchen, and king guest bedroomThird-floor master suite with king bed, en suite bath (garden tub & stand-up shower), and private balcony overlooking the GulfThird-floor bunk room (no door)Fourth-floor twin bed accessed via spiral staircase, with personal air conditionerOutdoor seating areas perfect for dining, relaxing, or enjoying the view3-vehicle driveway (garage for storage only)Laundry room with full-size washer and dryerTVs in all bedrooms except the fourth-floor twin nookClose to local dining and attractionsProperty Overview:Nestled on the quiet end of Wall Street, Coastal Gains is a classic Gulf-front beach home that captures the charm of Old Florida. Wake up to the sound of the surf and enjoy sweeping Gulf views from the main living area, gourmet kitchen, and master bedroom. Step outside for coffee on the deck or walk straight onto the sugar-white sands—it’s just steps from your door. With three king bedrooms, a twin room, a fourth-floor twin nook, and a custom bunk room with queen-over-queen and twin-over-twin beds, the home is perfect for families or group getaways.Tucked along a serene stretch of 30A, Inlet Beach offers a laid-back coastal vibe while keeping you just minutes from the shops and restaurants of 30Avenue and Rosemary Beach. Watch dolphins from the living room, enjoy a sunset dinner on the deck, or fall asleep to the rhythm of the waves—Coastal Gains brings you front and center to the magic of the Gulf.Parking:Driveway accommodates 3 vehicles. Garage is for storage only. Street parking is prohibited.Community Amenities:Take a stroll to the largest public beach access in South Walton, fish from the Gulf, or explore local shops and eateries. Neighboring communities like Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys Beach are just a short bike ride away.Reservation & Booking Policies:The 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement overrides third-party site policies (VRBO, HomeAway, Airbnb, etc.)No smoking, pets not allowed (except certified service animals with prior notice)Published rates exclude taxes and fees50% due at booking; balance due 60 days prior (or in full if within 60 days of arrival)5% cancellation fee; initial 50% refundable if canceled more than 60 days priorOptional travel insurance available if purchased before final paymentCheck-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTGuests must be at least 25 years old
